title: Size of the truth-table CNF
statement: Let $r\ge 0$ and let $f:\{\pm1\}^r\to\{\pm1\}$. The CNF formed with one clause for each assignment on which $f$ equals $+1$ has at most $2^r$ clauses.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from sign vectors of length $r$ to signs
